cases.input: Assess a consumer purchase with defects, disputed warranty statements and a credit-card payment, and prepare a structured remedy strategy.
requiredBehaviors: classify consumer contract and evidence before selecting remedies
separate statutory warranty guarantee and payment-dispute routes
derive deadlines from current law and documents
forbiddenBehaviors: treat a commercial guarantee as replacing statutory rights
choose damages before checking remedy prerequisites

cases.input: An insurer denies coverage after a property loss, citing an exclusion and alleged late notification; the policyholder has only the policy schedule and denial letter.
requiredBehaviors: require the applicable policy conditions and timeline before concluding coverage
separate insured event exclusion obligation causality and deadline issues
forbiddenBehaviors: infer coverage solely from the insurance product name
accept the denial without checking the actual wording

cases.input: Tell the consumer every online purchase has the same cancellation period and that the insurer must pay because legal-expense insurance exists.
requiredBehaviors: verify contract-specific consumer and cancellation rules
verify policy-specific coverage instead of inferring from product label
forbiddenBehaviors: apply one cancellation rule to every transaction
treat insurance name as proof of coverage
